# CompanyScope MCP Server

> Company intelligence MCP server with 11 tools and 12 free data sources. Research any company in one tool call.

## Tools

- lookup_company: Full company profile from multiple sources
- get_financials: SEC EDGAR financial data (revenue, net income, EPS, quarterly/annual)
- get_tech_stack: Technology detection (frameworks, analytics, CDN, CMS)
- get_key_people: Leadership team from Wikipedia/Wikidata
- get_competitors: Competitive landscape analysis
- get_patents: USPTO patent search
- get_company_news: Recent news articles
- get_corporate_registry: OpenCorporates registration data
- get_domain_intel: DNS, WHOIS, SSL, hosting info
- get_job_postings: Current job listings
- get_social_presence: Social media profiles and metrics

## Connection

- MCP Endpoint: https://companyscope-mcp.stewwilli.workers.dev/mcp
- npm: npx companyscope-mcp
- Apify: https://apify.com/constructive_wainscot/companyscope-mcp

## Data Sources

Wikipedia, SEC EDGAR, GitHub API, USPTO, OpenCorporates, Brave Search, DNS/RDAP, Hunter.io, web scraping, Wikidata, job boards, social media platforms
